what: For automating manual tasks: Claude Cowork (Desktop app) can spin up parallel sub-agents and use Computer Use for browser/desktop automation. Dispatch (mobile) lets you assign tasks remotely. For browser-specific automation, Playwright MCP is faster and cheaper than Computer Use (27K tokens vs 114K per task, DOM-based vs vision-based). Cowork can handle Phase 0 tasks (GitHub repo, npm publish, Vercel deploy, trademark search) in parallel. Limitation: Cowork controls one desktop — can't run two separate tool sessions (Claude Code + Cursor) simultaneously on same machine. User successfully used Cowork for P0.1 (Cloudflare domain setup).
why: Maps the right automation tool to each remaining task. Cowork for browser tasks, Claude Code for engineering, Playwright MCP for efficient browser automation.
